description: This file defines the Subscription API controller for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles various API calls related to subscriptions, including retrieving cart details, adding products, setting addresses, confirming subscriptions, and managing subscription history. It acts as an interface between HTTP requests and underlying models/services, orchestrating the subscription-related operations.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: API controller class for managing subscription-related API calls, including cart operations, address setting, subscription confirmation, and history management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the API, routing different 'call' parameters to respective methods and returning JSON response.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the customer context based on 'customer_id' in the request, logging in the customer and establishing session data.

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Sets the payment address in session using 'payment_address_id' from the request.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets the shipping address in session using 'shipping_address_id' from the request.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available shipping methods after ensuring customer and address info is set.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods after ensuring customer, address, and cart info is set.

methods.name: setPaymentMethod
methods.description: Sets the payment method and related details based on current session and cart info.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Retrieves cart details, including products, shipping, and payment options.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart and updates cart details.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms a subscription, validating all necessary data, creating or updating subscription records, and returning status.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds history notes or status updates to an existing subscription.
